remarks: Welcome to this light-filled end-unit residence in an intimate 14-home Pasadena community. Set among mature trees near shopping and business districts, this inviting home offers privacy, convenience, and effortless indoor-outdoor living. A gated courtyard leads to a dramatic living room with soaring 15-foot ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and two sliding glass doors opening to the private outdoor space. Newly installed wood flooring and a fireplace feature wall with cabinetry and shelving enhance the interior.
